rss_scope: Linux process VmRSS snapshots at leg endpoints; not per-frame cost, VRAM or an 8 GB certification

startup.scope: observer creation before scene change to first supported motion; frame intervals include main-thread/driver/presentation work, not exclusive GPU time or whole process launch
